featured_reviews.review_text:

Both Khushbu and Karan sir have excellent and in-depth knowledge of makeup. From proper skin prep and skincare products to makeup techniques, product selection, looks, and even guidance on poses, everything was explained and handled very professionally. The environment was comfortable, respectful, and encouraging, which made the entire experience very pleasant.
It was great to be part of such a positive learning space, and I truly appreciate the way they treat models with care and professionalism. Highly recommended for anyone looking to learn makeup seriously under knowledgeable mentors.

featured_reviews.name: veronica jetha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I completed the 1 month makeup course in jan  at the school of makeup n hair and the knowledge I gained is immersed. Our Teacher Karan sir taught us everything in depth n every detail was explained so well. From how to clean the brushes to how to Ace a look everything was taught step by step and this for a beginner like me was very important. Khushbu ma’am taught us all about marketing which was very informative and helpful. The school has a product library with all international brands and the best part is that you’re allowed to use those products on urself and on the models to understand and experience it.
What stood out for me about this school is that they genuinely want every student to learn and succeed hence along with makeup knowledge ma’am and Karan sir always kept encouraging all of us throughout which helped me build my confidence, learn from my mistakes and to work harder. One also gets the chance to go on shoots to learn and experience which is a big plus point.
This school not only teaches you the ABC of makeup but all the other aspects which will help you to be a successful MUA!
1) Product knowledge
2) Techniques
3) Marketing
4) self grooming
5) communication skills
From how to set your station to how to add that last touch before u let ur client go……everything is taught and that’s valuable!

The sweetest people Khushbu ma’am and Karan sir thank you!

featured_reviews.name: Anmol Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely loved my experience at the School of Makeup and Hair! The one-month course is super intensive, hands-on, and genuinely worth it. The trainers are incredibly skilled, supportive, and ensure you gain real confidence—not just basic skills. Perfect for anyone serious about building a career in makeup. Highly recommend! ✨

featured_reviews.name: Glamour By Kritika
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently completed a detailed professional makeup course at the School of Hair and Makeup, and I can honestly say it was one of the best decisions I’ve made for my career.
The course was extremely well-structured and covered everything in depth —from skin preparation, product knowledge, and color theory to bridal, party, editorial, and advanced techniques. Every topic was explained clearly with live demonstrations and hands-on practice, which helped me gain real confidence in my skills.A special mention to our teacher Karan Chugh Sir who was incredibly patient, supportive, and inspiring throughout the journey. He not only focused on technique but also shared valuable industry insights, client handling tips, and personal experiences that you won’t find in textbooks. His dedication and passion for teaching truly made a difference. He always encouraged us to improve, guided us individually, and never hesitated to clear even the smallest doubts.What really touched me was the goodwill gesture from the school — the supportive environment, extra practice opportunities, and the genuine encouragement they provide even after course completion. It doesn’t feel like just an institute; it feels like a mentor family that wants to see you grow. I am especially grateful to Khushbu who is so knowelagble, enthusiastic and caring and a sweetheart . She shared so many of her experiences with her marketing skills and social media handling from her own experience.I’m grateful to be a part of this learning experience and would highly recommend the School of Hair and Makeup to anyone who is serious about building a professional career in the beauty industry.

featured_reviews.name: Amy Srivastava
featured_reviews.review_text:
The one-month course at The School of Makeup and Hair exceeded all my expectations. The teaching is refined, detailed, and deeply industry-focused—every technique is explained with precision and purpose.

The makeup library is exceptional, with access to premium products and professional tools that truly elevate learning. What sets the school apart is the regular practice on models, which builds real confidence and prepares you for professional work from day one.

This isn’t just a course—it’s a polished, high-end learning experience that shapes you into a confident, industry-ready makeup artist. Highly recommended.
